steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cat /app/my-sql-query.sql
echo '---'
ls -la /app
echo '---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite '.tables'
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite '.schema words'
echo '---SENSES---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite '.schema senses'
echo '---SYNSETS---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite '.schema synsets'
echo '---INDEXES---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"
echo '---COUNTS---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',count(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',count(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',count(*) FROM synsets;"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT sqlite_version();"
echo '---synset dupes---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT synsetid FROM synsets GROUP BY synsetid HAVING count(*)>1);"
echo '---senses word-synset dupes---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*), max(c) FROM (SELECT wordid,synsetid,count(*) c FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid);"
echo '---senses senseid dupes---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT senseid FROM senses GROUP BY senseid HAVING count(*)>1);"
echo '---words dupes---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT wordid FROM words GROUP BY wordid HAVING count(*)>1);"
echo '---nulls---'
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT sum(wordid IS NULL), sum(synsetid IS NULL), sum(domainid IS NULL), sum(posid IS NULL) FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn USING(synsetid);"
EOF

sbx put /app/sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH per_synset AS (
  SELECT s.wordid,
         s.synsetid,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         syn.domainid,
         syn.posid
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid, syn.domainid, syn.posid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         synsetid,
         cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY wordid
           ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM per_synset
),
word_agg AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM per_synset
  GROUP BY wordid
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       wa.total_synsets,
       wa.total_senses,
       wa.distinct_domains,
       wa.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_agg wa
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = wa.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = wa.wordid AND r.rn = 1
WHERE wa.total_synsets >= 2
  AND wa.distinct_domains >= 2
  AND wa.total_senses >= 2
ORDER BY wa.total_senses DESC,
         wa.total_synsets DESC,
         wa.distinct_domains DESC,
         w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
cd /app
echo '--- candidate time ---'
/usr/bin/time -f '%e sec' sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /tmp/cand.txt
wc -l /tmp/cand.txt
md5sum /tmp/cand.txt
echo '--- original time ---'
/usr/bin/time -f '%e sec' sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig.txt
wc -l /tmp/orig.txt
md5sum /tmp/orig.txt
diff /tmp/orig.txt /tmp/cand.txt | head -50
EOF

sbx run <<'EOS'
pwd
ls -la /app /workspace | head -30
ls -la /app/sol.sql /workspace/sol.sql 2>&1
which time
EOS

sbx run <<'EOS'
cd /app
echo '--- candidate time ---'
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /tmp/cand.txt
wc -l /tmp/cand.txt
md5sum /tmp/cand.txt
echo '--- original time ---'
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig.txt
wc -l /tmp/orig.txt
md5sum /tmp/orig.txt
echo '--- diff ---'
diff /tmp/orig.txt /tmp/cand.txt | head -50
EOS

sbx run <<'EOS'
cat /app/sol.sql
echo '---'
grep -n -- '--' /app/sol.sql || true
EOS
